items.name: theme
items.title: swagui theme
items.description: Design tokens: type, radius, brand colour, canvas, surface, density and motion. Every value is a knob; there are no presets.

[data-surface=\"bevel\"].--shadow-raised:
0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 20%, transparent),
    0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)

[data-surface=\"glass\"].--shadow-raised:
inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--glass-rim), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-rim-soft),
    inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--glass-shade), 0 8px 32px -8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18)
[data-surface=\"glass\"].--shadow-overlay:
inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--glass-rim), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-rim-soft),
    inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--glass-shade), 0 24px 64px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28)

.glass-ground.background-image:
radial-gradient(
      42rem 32rem at 12% 8%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand) 18%, transparent),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      34rem 28rem at 88% 22%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 12%, transparent),
      transparent 62%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      38rem 30rem at 62% 88%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand) 12%, transparent),
      transparent 58%
    )

[data-surface=\"glass\"] [data-slot=\"bu.box-shadow:
inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--glass-rim-control),
    inset 0 0 0 1px var(--glass-rim-soft),
    inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--glass-shade),
    0 2px 10px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14)

.brand-glow.box-shadow:
0 0 36px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand) 8%, transparent),
      0 8px 50px 6px color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand) 5%, transparent)

.wave-once::before.background:
linear-gradient(
      100deg,
      transparent 38%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--wave-tone) 26%, transparent) 50%,
      transparent 62%
    )
